_comment: TRACE-Kin v3 config: v1 GNN backbone + ChemBERT (768) global graph context. ChemBERT is projected to hidden_channels via a single zero-initialized Linear and added as a residual to mol_pool before a fresh regression head. The dual-head/gate variant was dropped because an MLP cannot decompose ChemBERT's dense 768-d embedding the way RF can on small per-folder train sets. ChemBERT features come from per-row metabolite_features in the parquet files. patience=10 enables early stopping (FP-MLP runs peaked by epoch ~10).
